title: Reader POST path: call verify_article at ingest
description:
Wire the verification pipeline into the reader's POST handler.

What: crates/reader/src/post/ipfs_write.rs (or wherever POST pipeline lands after IPFS write); crates/reader/src/store/server_stores.rs

Changes:
1. Add verify_store: Option<Arc<VerifyStore>> to ServerStores.
2. Add dkim_resolver: Option<Arc<mail_auth::Resolver>> to ServerStores (None disables DKIM).
3. After article is written to IPFS and CID is known, call:
     if let Some(vs) = &stores.verify_store {
         let _ = verify_article(raw_bytes, &cid, vs, stores.dkim_resolver.as_deref()).await;
     }
4. verify_article() runs both verifiers (usenet-ipfs-sig always; dkim if resolver present).
5. Errors from verify_article never propagate to the caller (verification is non-fatal).
6. Add verify_store and dkim_resolver construction to build helpers; set to None in all integration tests that don't need verification.

pub async fn verify_article(raw: &[u8], cid: &Cid, store: &VerifyStore, resolver: Option<&Resolver>) -> ()
  - calls verify_usenet_sig + verify_dkim
  - calls store.record_verification for each result
  - logs info! summary: article_cid, checks run, results

Defensive rules:
- Wrap entire verify_article body in a catch-unwind or handle all errors internally; never let a verification panic abort article ingest.
- Log at info level: 'verified cid={} sig={} dkim={}'; never log key material.
